headline: Abbott Laboratories Lost 16% This Year: One Analyst Sees 35% Gains for the Healthcare Giant
summary: Abbott Laboratories has shed billions in market value this year while the broader market climbed, yet one analyst on Wall Street sees a dramatically different story unfolding beneath the surface of the company's bruised financials.
